$comment: Greens sampled from the master logo artwork, not the national brand guide — the two disagree. Sampled 2026-07-25 from logos/master/eckb-melbourne-logo.png. All contrast figures measured with the WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance formula, not estimated.

paper.usage: Default light ground. Warmer than white; keeps the green from vibrating.

night.usage: Default dark ground. Not pure black — pure black inverts most violently in mail clients.

green.note: Primary. 37% of opaque pixels in the master logo.
green.usage: FILL on light grounds — bands, buttons, rules, logo lockups. Legitimate TEXT colour on dark grounds only.

greenMid.usage: Large headings on light (18pt+, or 14pt bold). Below 4.5 — not body text.

greenDark.usage: Body text on light grounds. The workhorse. AAA.

greenDeep.usage: Headings, borders, and — critically — text sitting ON a green fill.

ball.derivation: Proposed, not sampled. Stands for the red kickball the national guide calls 'a big red and campy ball'. Chosen to clear AA on both grounds; replace with a sampled value if the ball's true colour is ever measured.
ball.usage: Live/active state only — 'now' tags, EOI markers, focus rings, errors. Never decorative.

muted.derivation: Desaturated from the green hue, not neutral grey — grey reads as dead next to the brand green.
muted.usage: Captions, eyebrows, secondary labels on light grounds.

rule.usage: Dividers and borders on light grounds. Non-text — contrast floor does not apply.

accent.$comment: The national guide names these two greens for social feed posts. Both are unusable on the white ground the same guide requires — but they are the strongest colours in the palette on dark. This system keeps them as accent roles rather than discarding them.

lime.usage: Dark-ground accent and highlight. Never on white.

grass.usage: Dark-ground headings and display numerals. Never on white.

pairings.$comment: Load-bearing rules. The first is the one most often got wrong.

rejected.reason: White on brand green FAILS. It looks correct and is not.

type.fallback: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
type.note: Variable, with a width axis. Expanded widths read as painted signage. Never set body copy in an expanded width — width is a display device.

space.$comment: Single rhythm. More space above a heading than below it.

email.$comment: Values that must be inlined as literal hex — mail clients do not support custom properties.
email.safeFont: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
